## Description

Members now presents identity, read-only role and action in labelled rows. The heading counts active rows while the separate product-access count keeps its existing meaning. Quiet native Remove… and Leave… disclosures replace the prominent initial removal buttons; trusted subject identity selects You and Leave.

Confirmation keeps the person, workspace, consequences, Cancel and protected form fields. Only the final confirmation is red. Rows stack through tablet widths so expanded confirmations and long values remain readable. Existing server safeguards, refusal states, recovery links and approved help stay intact; no new JavaScript or provider reads are needed.

Stacked on [UI-01 #263](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/263) at `a017020e`. UI-03/04 invitation work remains separate.

## Review

**T1 Team review** — Architecture: T0: no architecture fact. The trusted `read_paths` rule separately selects T1 for `docs/implementation/test-gate-policy.md`; that edit only describes the expanded browser gate.

**Architecture facts** — candidate `e8f097da` against parent `a017020e`:

- None.

[Impact declaration](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e8f097dacad194fd3d540dee2fd79b52563e50c2/.pr-impact.json): all flags remain false. Production architecture is unchanged inside Web, with the same overview, checked removal POST, authority and lifetime. All 15 registry views and 49 public snapshots remain unchanged.

**Merge status: blocked pending independent owner/team approval of this candidate.** The local checker has no technical blocker; selected validation is complete. Parent #263 must land before this child is integrated into main. No merge or deployment is included in this request. [Full evidence](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/1c18a2751a1e44cfa53a9f8c05cf31857c7480c4/review-evidence/ui-02/e8f097dacad194fd3d540dee2fd79b52563e50c2/README.md) includes the retained findings and corrected image-provenance attempt.
